items.title: Where exactly does the unclamped discount function break?
items.description: Drag the combined discount percentage and watch the buggy version (no clamp) and the fixed version (clamped to [0, 100]) compute the resulting price. The default (110%) reproduces the opening scenario's exact case — the two agree everywhere under 100%, then diverge sharply once the combined discount crosses it.
items.compute: function buggy(d) { return Math.round(100 * (1 - d / 100) * 100) / 100; } function fixed(d) { const c = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, d)); return Math.round(100 * (1 - c / 100) * 100) / 100; } return { buggyPrice: buggy(params.combinedDiscountPercent), fixedPrice: fixed(params.combinedDiscountPercent) };
